# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

# Chap3 – Jenga Workspace
# Generated by `jenga workspace` on 2026-09-30 16:08:52

from Jenga import *
from Jenga.GlobalToolchains import RegisterJengaGlobalToolchains

ENGINE = "../Jenga/Jenga/Exemples/27_nk_window"

with workspace("Chap3", location="."):
    
    RegisterJengaGlobalToolchains()

    configurations(["Debug", "Release"])
    targetoses([TargetOS.WINDOWS])
    targetarchs([TargetArch.X86_64])

    with project("NKWindow"):
        staticlib()
        language("C++")
        cppdialect("C++17")
        location(ENGINE + "/NKWindow")
        includedirs(["src", "../Externals"])
        files([
            "src/NKWindow/Core/**.cpp",
            "src/NKWindow/Renderer/**.cpp",
            "src/NKWindow/Platform/Win32/**.cpp",
        ])
        usetoolchain("clang-mingw")
        defines([
            "NKENTSEU_PLATFORM_WIN32=1",
            "NKENTSEU_PLATFORM_WINDOWS=1",
            "WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN",
            "_UNICODE",
            "UNICODE",
        ])
        links([
            "user32", "gdi32", "opengl32", "dwmapi", "shell32", "xinput",
            "mf", "mfplat", "mfreadwrite", "mfuuid", "uuid", "ole32",
        ])
        objdir("%{wks.location}/Build/Obj/%{cfg.buildcfg}/%{prj.name}")
        targetdir("%{wks.location}/Build/Bin/%{cfg.buildcfg}/%{prj.name}")

    with project("Chap3"):
        windowedapp()
        language("C++")
        cppdialect("C++17")
        location(".")
        files(["src/main.cpp"])
        includedirs([ENGINE + "/NKWindow/src", ENGINE + "/Externals"])
        usetoolchain("clang-mingw")
        defines(["NKENTSEU_PLATFORM_WIN32=1"])
        links([
            "NKWindow",
            "user32", "gdi32", "opengl32", "dwmapi", "shell32", "xinput",
            "mf", "mfplat", "mfreadwrite", "mfuuid", "uuid", "ole32",
        ])
        dependson(["NKWindow"])
        objdir("%{wks.location}/Build/Obj/%{cfg.buildcfg}/%{prj.name}")
        targetdir("%{wks.location}/Build/Bin/%{cfg.buildcfg}/%{prj.name}")

    startproject("Chap3")
